Predicted to be near-identical to the base -- the 5:1 bracket rarely binds (rounds 17/18 measured 0.14pp) -- and the report tool counts how many of this arm's closed trades actually exited on the target. Pre-registered 2026-09-09, before any measurement (see strategy-program/ROUND-45-PLAN.md and strategy-program/MIX-AND-MATCH-PLAN.md section 3). Nothing here is promotable -- the `trading` purpose is exempt from PROTOCOL.md section 6 promotion (r21 amendment); this is a measurement study, report only. Not investment advice.
